//: Install verdict cases that apps/web/lib/agent/verdict.test.ts and packages/cli/test/explain.test.ts both run, so the website's explain_install and `apm explain` cannot drift apart. Every name is x, every range latest; lost points are what the score lost (with an id where the verdict reads it: a risk signal, a gap, incomplete). coverage is the verdict's structured coverage field and notes its notes; both copies must give them. A review of kind answer is the registry's raw GET /-/apm/v1/review answer (status and body): each copy reads it through its own parser, so a field one of them drops shows up here. `older` is what the explain step did about a picked version inside the cooldown. Since the agent-native policy (2026-11) review-first is for a real risk (a risk signal, a score under the floor, an open AI flag, a dependency flagged the same way, a version inside the cooldown apm cannot clear) and, fail-closed, for an analysis apm could not finish: only one whose sole gap is whole files left unread for their size or the byte budget, on apm-score-v11's own record, installs with a note. `coverage` in resolve is the report's coverage as the registry sends it, read through each copy's parser; a warning's `coverage` and `unscorable` likewise. A version with no score and no record that apm can never score it (queued, or no word on why) is unknown: a queued version is pending, never clean. do-not-install is only for revoked, yanked and confirmed malicious.
